title: Center of Mass of a Uniform Solid Hemisphere
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the vertical center of mass z_bar of a uniform solid hemisphere of radius R = 8 centered at the origin for z >= 0.

steps.title: Recall Hemisphere Centroid Formula
steps.explanation: The center of mass of a uniform solid hemisphere of radius R lies at distance (3/8)R from the flat base.
steps.why: Using geometric centroid property of hemisphere.
